desc: From hammer to muzzle, the 2K11 has been built around all the features Kimber enthusiasts requested. An enhanced sub-frame shaped for superior magazine fit and control, plus an accessory rail for optional lights and lasers. The 2K11 is also the introduction of the patent-pending tool-less guide rod. The new GT trigger with a 3-4lb pull is precision machined and finished for a clean, crisp break.
